dag.description: Terminal Bedrock LLM labeling / audit pipeline over a Cradle-sourced dataset. Cradle SQL loads the audit population, TabularPreprocessing shapes it, BedrockProcessing scores/annotates each record under a generated prompt template, and LabelRulesetExecution applies a generated label ruleset to emit final labels or audit decisions. No model training, packaging, or registration — the output is the labeled/decisioned dataset.

agent_context.when_to_use: Generate LLM-derived labels or audit decisions over a Cradle-sourced dataset using Bedrock (gated by a generated prompt template) and a declarative label ruleset, WITHOUT training a model. Use for weak-supervision label generation, audit/QA sampling, or offline LLM scoring where the deliverable is the labeled dataset. This is the rnr_audit_bedrock NA DAG.
agent_context.when_not_to_use: If you then train a model in the same DAG, use bedrock_pytorch_with_label_ruleset_e2e or bedrock_pytorch_with_label_ruleset_percentile_e2e. If you do not need a label ruleset (plain LLM enrichment/scoring), use bedrock_data_processing_with_prompt_template. If input is pre-staged/Dummy rather than a live Cradle SQL, adjust the loader accordingly.
differentiators: Terminal labeling/audit DAG — no training, packaging, or registration tail
Combines Bedrock LLM scoring (prompt-template-gated) with a generated label ruleset to emit labels/decisions

prerequisites.check: Cradle SQL for the audit population
prerequisites.how: CradleDataLoading_training profile returns the rows to label
LabelRulesetGeneration emits the ruleset applied by LabelRulesetExecution_training

common_pitfalls: LabelRulesetExecution depends on BOTH BedrockProcessing output and the generated ruleset
Prompt template output fields must align with the fields the ruleset expects
This DAG has no registration — downstream consumers read the emitted labeled dataset, not a MIMS model
